purpose: Per CEO R295 P1+P5: 'Make economics fields machine-updating with provenance for each transition. Build portfolio optimizer around evidence cost. EV(next action) = P(technical progress) × P(buyer engagement) × expected transaction value − evidence cost. Each probability must have state: MODELLED / CALIBRATED / BUYER_VERIFIED.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXVII (no threshold invention — all probabilities have provenance). Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion — MODELLED ≠ CALIBRATED ≠ BUYER_VERIFIED).

tier_2_expected_buyer_value.updates_when: New market data or buyer feedback

tier_3_buyer_indicated_wtp.transition_rule: A buyer saying 'interesting' does NOT update WTP. A buyer saying 'we would pay $75K for this evaluation' DOES.

tier_4_actual_offer.provenance: Buyer offer letter or term sheet

P_technical_progress.description: Probability that the next evidence action produces positive technical progress
P_technical_progress.rule: Starts as MODELLED. Becomes CALIBRATED when computational evidence confirms the mechanism. Becomes BUYER_VERIFIED when an external party confirms.

P_buyer_engagement.description: Probability that a buyer engages in technical evaluation
states: CALIBRATED (updated by buyer response — even rejection calibrates)
P_buyer_engagement.rule: Starts as MODELLED. Becomes CALIBRATED when a buyer responds (positive OR negative — both calibrate). Becomes BUYER_VERIFIED when buyer commits to evaluation.

expected_transaction_value.description: Expected transaction value if technical and buyer probabilities are realized
expected_transaction_value.rule: Starts at Tier 1 target price. Adjusts to Tier 3 when buyer indicates WTP. Adjusts to Tier 4 when buyer makes offer. Becomes Tier 5 at transaction.

optimizer_formula: EV(next evidence action) = P(technical progress) × P(buyer engagement) × expected_transaction_value − evidence_cost

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Neuromorphic Failure Predictor

P_technical.rationale: ML failure prediction is established (2023 study ROC AUC 0.733). Neuromorphic adaptation is novel but feasible.

P_buyer.rationale: Medtronic/Abbott have AI divisions. No contact yet.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Search for public implant failure dataset. $0 cost. If dataset found, P_technical increases. If not found, P_technical drops to 0.20 and EV drops to $12,000 — re-rank.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Energy-Neutral Micro-Assist

P_technical.rationale: Energy harvesting from low-flow CSF is uncertain. Cardiac flow harvesting is more feasible.

P_buyer.rationale: Medtronic/Abbott have strong implant power programs. Pain is real (battery replacement).

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Compute energy budget from CSF flow (0.3 mL/min, 12 mmHg). $0-5K. If P_available > 10× P_required, P_technical jumps to 0.60. If P_available < P_required, P_technical drops to 0.05.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Self-Powered Physiologic Sensing

P_technical.rationale: Cardiac motion harvesting has more literature support than CSF flow. Sensor power is low.

P_buyer.rationale: Same buyers as P-08. Battery elimination is universal pain.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Compute energy budget from cardiac motion (0.5-2 Hz, 10-30% amplitude). $0-5K. Same contingency as P-08.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Rate-Limited Physiologic Conductance Control

P_technical.rationale: 225-run ablation confirms rate limiting. 180-run comparison shows 2-3x advantage. Computational evidence is strong.

P_buyer.rationale: Miethke identified as best fit. No contact yet. Shunt market has fewer buyers than ortho/cardio.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Build physical bench ($7-10K). Send Buyer Kit to Miethke. Bench validation moves P_technical to BUYER_VERIFIED if external lab confirms.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Selective Fail-Operational Membrane

P_technical.rationale: Membrane geometry is well-understood engineering. Fail-operational design is novel but computationally testable.

P_buyer.rationale: Pall/Danaher, Sartorius. Filtration companies buy technology assets. But membrane innovation is incremental.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Build computational model of fail-operational membrane geometry. $3-10K.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Phage-Based Anti-Biofilm Defense

P_technical.rationale: Phage therapy exists but phage COATING on implants is novel. Unknown if phages survive immobilization. High technical risk.

P_buyer.rationale: Orthopedic market is BEST for asset packages. 1000+ companies. Infection is #1 pain. Stryker/Zimmer actively acquire coating tech.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Literature review: phage species vs S. aureus biofilm + immobilization chemistry. $5-15K. If phage+immobilization is feasible, P_technical jumps to 0.50.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Phase-Change Valve Actuation

P_technical.rationale: Phase-change materials exist. Question: is transition near 37°C achievable with safe materials?

P_buyer.rationale: Valve companies (Edwards, Medtronic). But valve actuation is a component, not a product. Lower buyer urgency.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Literature review of phase-change materials near 37°C. $3-10K.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Pulsation-Synchronized Catalytic Contact-Time Lock

P_technical.rationale: Engineering is specified but biology is unfrozen. Enzyme may not survive CSF. High risk.

P_buyer.rationale: AbbVie/Lilly have Alzheimer's programs. NPH+AD comorbidity is real pain. But combination product is complex.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Engage enzyme collaborator. Execute Phase 1 wet-lab ($40-80K). High cost but high value.

P_technical.rationale: Tau-degrading enzymes exist but chronic CSF stability is unknown. Similar risk to P-04.

P_buyer.rationale: Denali/Alector have CNS programs. But local CSF clearance is a new concept for them.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Adaptive Valve Pressure-Response Profile

P_technical.rationale: Compliance estimation is computationally feasible but clinically unvalidated.

P_buyer.rationale: Shunt valve companies. But adaptive profiling is incremental over existing programmable valves.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Build computational model of adaptive profiling. $5-15K.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Washout-Gated Drug Release

P_technical.rationale: Flow-gated release is mechanically feasible but drug stability in CSF is unknown.

P_buyer.rationale: Medtronic SynchroMed. But intrathecal pump market is small and dominated.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Build computational model of flow-gated release. $5-15K.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Production-Matched Drainage

P_technical.rationale: Production estimation from ICP recovery is theoretically possible but unvalidated.

P_buyer.rationale: Could bundle with P-01. Standalone value is lower. US12636471 may cover.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Build CSF production estimator. $5-15K. Or bundle with P-01.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Chemical ICP Transduction Platform

P_technical.rationale: Molecule may not exist. 20-40% success probability. Highest technical risk in portfolio.

P_buyer.rationale: Research collaboration only. No product buyer until molecule is found.

expected_value.rationale: If molecule found: $200-500K. Expected value adjusted by 0.30 success probability.

optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: Molecule-selection Step 1. $200-500K. Negative EV until molecule is found. Research investment, not commercial package.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Residual Conductance Floor (bundled with P-01)

P_technical.rationale: Ablation evidence exists. Bundled with P-01.

optimizer_ranking_R295.EV: Bundled with P-01. No standalone action.
optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: NONE standalone. Validate as part of P-01 bench.

optimizer_ranking_R295.name: Drainage-Priority Clearance (bundled with P-04)
optimizer_ranking_R295.EV: Bundled with P-04. No standalone action.
optimizer_ranking_R295.next_action: NONE standalone. Validate as part of P-04 wet-lab.

track_A_revenue_acceleration.principle: Cheapest evidence first. No emotional attachment. If P-13 dataset doesn't exist, re-rank immediately.
track_A_revenue_acceleration.next_24_hours: P-13 dataset search ($0). P-08/P-15 energy budget computation ($0-5K each).

track_B_flagship_strategic.principle: High-value, high-cost. Continue in parallel with Track A.
track_B_flagship_strategic.next_24_hours: P-01: send Buyer Kit to Miethke. P-04: engage enzyme collaborator.

bundled.principle: No standalone action. Validate with parent package.

waiting.principle: Lower EV. Will be activated when Track A produces cash or when portfolio optimizer re-ranks.

the_learning_loop.step_1: Run cheapest evidence action (e.g., P-13 dataset search)
the_learning_loop.step_2: Result updates P_technical (MODELLED → CALIBRATED if positive, drops if negative)
the_learning_loop.step_4: If P_technical increased, approach buyer → buyer response updates P_buyer (MODELLED → CALIBRATED)
the_learning_loop.step_6: If buyer engages, buyer WTP updates expected_value (MODELLED → BUYER_VERIFIED)
the_learning_loop.step_8: If buyer offers, Tier 4 fills (NEGOTIATION state)
the_learning_loop.step_9: If buyer pays, Tier 5 fills (TRANSACTION state) → portfolio learning → resources reallocated to next-highest-EV candidate
the_learning_loop.principle: Every real-world result (technical or buyer) immediately updates the probabilities and re-ranks the portfolio. The machine becomes more accurate with every data point.
